meta.title: 赤いスイートピー

lyrics.ja: 春色の汽車に乗って海に連れて行ってよ
lyrics.romaji: Haruiro no Kisha ni Notte Umi ni Tsurete Itte yo
lyrics.en: Take me on a spring-colored train to the sea
lyrics.zh: 搭上春色火車，帶我去海邊吧

lyrics.ja: 煙草の匂いのシャツにそっと寄りそうから
lyrics.romaji: Tabako no Nioi no Shatsu ni Sotto Yorisou kara
lyrics.en: Because I'll gently lean close to your shirt that smells of tobacco
lyrics.zh: 因為我會輕輕依偎在你帶著菸草味的襯衫上

lyrics.ja: 何故　知りあった日から半年過ぎても
lyrics.romaji: Naze Shiriattta Hi kara Hantoshi Sugite mo
lyrics.en: Why, even though half a year has passed since we met
lyrics.zh: 為何從相識那天起已過了半年

lyrics.ja: あなたって手も握らない
lyrics.romaji: Anata tte Te mo Nigiranai
lyrics.en: You won't even hold my hand
lyrics.zh: 你卻連手都不握

lyrics.ja: I will follow you　あなたに
lyrics.romaji: I Will Follow You Anata ni
lyrics.en: I will follow you—after you
lyrics.zh: I will follow you 跟隨你

lyrics.ja: ついてゆきたい
lyrics.romaji: Tsuite Yukitai
lyrics.en: I want to follow
lyrics.zh: 想跟隨你而去

lyrics.ja: I will follow you　ちょっぴり
lyrics.romaji: I Will Follow You Choppiri
lyrics.en: I will follow you—just a little
lyrics.zh: I will follow you 雖然有點

lyrics.ja: 気が弱いけど
lyrics.romaji: Ki ga Yowai kedo
lyrics.en: Timid at heart
lyrics.zh: 膽小軟弱

lyrics.ja: 素敵な人だから
lyrics.romaji: Suteki na Hito Dakara
lyrics.en: But because you're a wonderful person
lyrics.zh: 但因為你是個很棒的人

lyrics.ja: 心の岸辺に咲いた　赤いスイートピー
lyrics.romaji: Kokoro no Kishibe ni Saita Akai Suiito Pii
lyrics.en: A red sweet pea bloomed on the shore of my heart
lyrics.zh: 在心的岸邊綻放的紅色甜豌豆花

lyrics.ja: 四月の雨に降られて駅のベンチで二人
lyrics.romaji: Shigatsu no Ame ni Furarete Eki no Benchi de Futari
lyrics.en: Caught in April rain, the two of us on a station bench
lyrics.zh: 被四月的雨淋濕，兩人坐在車站的長椅上

lyrics.ja: 他に人影もなくて不意に気まずくなる
lyrics.romaji: Hoka ni Hitokage mo Nakute Fui ni Kimazuku Naru
lyrics.en: With no one else around, it suddenly feels awkward
lyrics.zh: 沒有其他人影，突然變得尷尬

lyrics.ja: 何故　あなたが時計をチラッと見るたび
lyrics.romaji: Naze Anata ga Tokei wo Chiratto Miru Tabi
lyrics.en: Why, every time you glance at your watch
lyrics.zh: 為何每當你瞥一眼手錶

lyrics.ja: 泣きそうな気分になるの？
lyrics.romaji: Nakisou na Kibun ni Naru no?
lyrics.en: Do I feel like crying?
lyrics.zh: 我就快要哭出來？

lyrics.ja: I will follow you　翼の
lyrics.romaji: I Will Follow You Tsubasa no
lyrics.en: I will follow you—with boots
lyrics.zh: I will follow you 長著翅膀的

lyrics.ja: 生えたブーツで
lyrics.romaji: Haeta Buutsu de
lyrics.en: That have wings
lyrics.zh: 靴子

lyrics.ja: I will follow you　あなたと
lyrics.romaji: I Will Follow You Anata to
lyrics.en: I will follow you—with you
lyrics.zh: I will follow you 與你

lyrics.ja: 同じ青春
lyrics.romaji: Onaji Seishun
lyrics.en: The same youth
lyrics.zh: 相同的青春

lyrics.ja: 走ってゆきたいの
lyrics.romaji: Hashitte Yukitai no
lyrics.en: I want to run through it
lyrics.zh: 想要一起奔跑

lyrics.ja: 線路の脇のつぼみは　赤いスイートピー
lyrics.romaji: Senro no Waki no Tsubomi ha Akai Suiito Pii
lyrics.en: The bud beside the railway tracks is a red sweet pea
lyrics.zh: 鐵軌旁的花苞，是紅色甜豌豆花

lyrics.ja: 好きよ　今日まで
lyrics.romaji: Suki yo Kyou made
lyrics.en: I love you—more than anyone
lyrics.zh: 喜歡你，至今為止

lyrics.ja: 逢った誰より
lyrics.romaji: Atta Dare yori
lyrics.en: I've ever met
lyrics.zh: 遇見過的任何人

lyrics.ja: I will follow you　あなたの
lyrics.romaji: I Will Follow You Anata no
lyrics.en: I will follow you—your way
lyrics.zh: I will follow you 你的人生

lyrics.ja: 生き方が好き
lyrics.romaji: Ikikata ga Suki
lyrics.en: I love how you live
lyrics.zh: 我喜歡你的生活方式

lyrics.ja: このまま帰れない　帰れない
lyrics.romaji: Kono Mama Kaerenai Kaerenai
lyrics.en: I can't go back like this—I can't go back
lyrics.zh: 就這樣無法回頭，無法回頭

lyrics.ja: 心に春が来た日は　赤いスイートピー
lyrics.romaji: Kokoro ni Haru ga Kita Hi ha Akai Suiito Pii
lyrics.en: On the day spring came to my heart—a red sweet pea
lyrics.zh: 當春天來到心間的那天，紅色甜豌豆花
